name: Spiff.store

sources.title: Spiff.store homepage - curated AI tools directory
Submit Your AI Tool - Free (2-month wait, nofollow) vs Fastlane $15 (2 days, dofollow)

conditions: Free listing exists but has a stated 2-month waiting time and only 1 NO-FOLLOW backlink
Fastlane Listing ($15 one-time) lists within ~2 business days with do-follow backlinks, homepage + sitewide feature, listing on 10+ sister sites, blog mention, and social shares
requirements: FAQ: any website displaying sexual or violent content is not allowed
Both tiers promise a dedicated listing page
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, category fit
Decision between free queue (2 months) and $15 Fastlane (2 days)
workflow: Go to https://spiff.store/submit-tool ('Submit Tool' in nav)
Choose 'Free Listing' ($0, ~2 months, nofollow link) or 'Fastlane Listing' ($15, ~2 days, dofollow)
Click 'Submit AI Tool' under the chosen plan and complete the form
Wait for the listing to publish; a 'Visit Website' outbound link appears on the listing card
watchFor: Free tier is explicitly NOFOLLOW — the catalog 'link=follow' note applies only to the paid Fastlane tier
Fastlane promises '100+ do-follow backlinks' via 10+ sister sites — a link-network pattern; footer sister sites include backlinksforsale.com, a paid-link shop
Marketing copy claims 'Increased Domain Authority / boost in SEO traffic' — treat as sales language, not guarantees
The submit page brands the site 'AITools Directory' in the footer — sister-site network
countsAsLive: A tool card with a 'Visit Website' link appears on spiff.store (homepage grid and category pages)
unknowns: Exact form fields after clicking 'Submit AI Tool'
Whether the 2-month free queue is enforced or shorter in practice
Rejection criteria beyond the sexual/violent content ban
